business_problem: Auxilion needed a service-management operating model that could integrate customer environments, rationalize data trapped in legacy systems, and scale managed support for SMB customers without adding more complexity, risk, or manual work for agents.
solution_summary: Auxilion rebuilt its managed-services operating model around Technology Provider Service Management (TPSM) so it could serve SMB customers in Ireland and the UK with less complexity and more automation. TPSM and its single data model sit at the center of the environment, integrating customer ecosystems and orchestrating data that had previously been held in disparate legacy systems into one service-management backbone. On top of that shared model, Auxilion uses TPSM to run structured customer onboarding, switch agents securely between customer organizations and teams, and generate proactive cases with real-time insights so communication stays consistent as issues emerge. The same platform also simplifies technology-infrastructure management by giving teams a unified view of tools and systems, while AI and machine learning support fast, secure data acquisition and rationalization during onboarding.

solution_components.name: Technology Provider Service Management
solution_components.role: Provides the single data model and managed-services workflow backbone for onboarding, case orchestration, and customer support.

data_flow: Customer and legacy-system data is acquired during onboarding, rationalized with AI and machine learning, and unified inside TPSM's single data model. TPSM then orchestrates service workflows, proactive case generation, and secure agent switching across customer teams, with real-time insights flowing back to agents and customers for faster communication and support.
business_outcome: Auxilion turned the TPSM rollout into €8 million of new business, maintained 100% platform reliability, and created a lower-risk service model that helps customers onboard faster and scale support more efficiently.
architecture_clues: TPSM's single data model sits at the core of Auxilion's service-management ecosystem.
Auxilion is migrating customers into a one-to-many delivery model so agents can switch securely between organizations and teams.
AI and machine learning are used during onboarding for fast, secure data acquisition and rationalization.
evidence_quotes: We’re investing in ServiceNow TPSM because of the huge advance in service management capability that it offers.

Auxilion’s new service management ecosystem, with TPSM and its single data model at its core, allows it to integrate with customer ecosystems, to orchestrate previously disparate data held in legacy systems, and to improve transparency, quality, and speed of service.
Agents proactively serve customers with real-time insights, while the automatic generation of proactive cases ensures better communication and a seamless experience.
In fact, Auxilion’s investment has paid dividends in the form of new business wins worth €8 million.

TPSM also provides structured, repeatable, and transparent customer onboarding into Auxilion’s ecosystem, through the fast, efficient, and secure acquisition and rationalization of data, utilizing AI and machine learning.
